item.title: Can Post-Supply Trade Discounts Reduce GST Transaction Value? Allahabad HC to Examine Oppo Mobile’s Plea [Read Order]
item.description: The Court observed that a prima facie case exists to invite deeper scrutiny on the validity of statutory conditions governing post-supply trade discounts under GST

item.title: Allahabad HC Stays ₹13 Cr GST Demand Against Dell India After Plea of Jurisdictional Error Raised [Read Order]
item.description: It is trite law that tax demand raised cannot be enhanced beyond the scope of the demand in the show cause notice preceding the order passed after adjudication.

item.title: Can Criminal Proceedings be Initiated for Cash Transactions Above ₹2 Lakh? Allahabad HC to Examine S.269ST of Income Tax Act [Read Order]
item.description: The applicant sought the quashal of a charge-sheet and entire proceeding pending before a magistrate at Saharanpur

item.title: Ex-BSNL Employees Absorbed from DoT Treated as Central Govt. Retirees for Income Tax Exemption on Leave Encashment: Kerala HC [Read Order]
item.description: The Court held that the retirement of DoT employees who were absorbed into BSNL must be treated as retirement from Central Government service for purposes of Section 10(10AA)(i).

item.title: Hindustan Shipyard Not Liable to Include Travel & Accommodation Costs of Foreign Consultants in Service Tax Value: CESTAT [Read Order]
item.description: The Commissioner of Central Excise had earlier dropped proceedings, holding that such expenses had already suffered service tax when paid to Indian service providers (like hotels and airlines), and inclusion would amount to double taxation.

item.title: Executive Instructions Cannot Amend Statutory Provisions: Kerala HC Quashes BSNL Corporate Office Letter Mandating TDS on Leave Encashment [Read Order]
item.description: The Court held that a corporate office letter provided within BSNL cannot override statutory provisions.

item.title: GST Authorities Must Serve ‘Grounds of Arrest’ in Writing: Allahabad HC allows Habeas Corpus Petition [Read Order]
item.description: While the “reasons to believe” recorded by the Commissioner are not required to be supplied to the accused, the grounds of arrest must be clearly communicated and provided in writing to the arrested person

item.title: Conversion of Company into LLP Deemed Dissolution of Company: ITAT rules Reassessment Cannot Survive [Read Order]
item.description: As per Section 58(4)(c) of the LLP Act, upon conversion of a company into an LLP, the company shall be deemed to be dissolved and removed from the records of the Registrar of Companies.

item.title: Govt Liable to Reimburse Additional GST from Tax Neutrality Mechanism: Allahabad HC [Read Order]
item.description: The High Court looked at Clause 5 of the Joint Procedure Order from January 21, 2018. This clause explains how to make sure that contracts are tax-neutral during the switch from the pre-GST regime to the GST regime.
